device.description: Path to the block device or disk image file to scan (e.g., /dev/sda)

sector_size.description: Sector size in bytes (must be power of two: 512–16384)

skip_sectors.description: Number of sectors to skip before scanning starts

max_sector.description: Last sector index to scan (0 = scan to end of device)

modules.description: Ordered list of filesystem modules to probe, each with optional weight; supported: beos, bsddl, ext2, fat, hpfs, hmlvm, lswap, minix, ntfs, qnx4, reiserfs, s86dl, xfs

write_device.description: Device or file path to write the guessed partition table to

backup_file.description: Path to backup file for current MBR before writing

log_file.description: Path to log file; output written here even in quiet mode

full_scan.description: Enable full sector-by-sector scan (do not skip regions of guessed partitions)

check_mode.description: Enable comparison of guessed vs actual partition table; exit code = number of differences

do_not_guess.description: Skip scanning and only print current partition table (requires verbose mode)

skip_extended.description: Do not attempt to recognize extended partition chains

do_not_get_geometry.description: Ignore geometry reported by the OS (useful for disk image files)

interactive.description: Prompt the user before accepting each detected partition

quiet.description: Suppress normal output; exceptions written to log_file if set

verbose.description: Verbosity level; each increment adds detail (e.g., -vv = 2)
